title: Same Tree
keyIdea: Walk both trees together. Both NULL → same. One NULL → different. Values differ → different. Otherwise the left subtrees and the right subtrees must both be the same.

approaches.name: BFS on pairs
approaches.idea: Queue pairs of nodes at the same position; any mismatch in presence or value → false.
approaches.why: Each pair is checked once; the queue holds about one level.

approaches.name: Recursion
approaches.idea: Both NULL → true; one NULL → false; equal values → isSameTree(left, left) && isSameTree(right, right).
approaches.why: One call per node pair; stops at the first difference thanks to &&.

options: If both are NULL, they're equal; only after ruling that out does "one NULL" mean different
No: same values, but the 2 is on different sides

quiz.q: What does && do when the left pair is already different?
options: The right pair is never checked
It checks the right pair first
